subject.title: [Bug] Telegram exec approval bubble not dismissed after clicking approve

question: Should maintainers close or adopt the open conflicting fork PR before authorizing a new narrow current-main fix for this Telegram approval cleanup?
rationale: Automation should not queue another fix while an open closing PR still references this issue, but that PR is conflicting and targets the removed handler path.

options.title: Close fork and queue narrow fix
options.body: Close the conflicting fork PR as obsolete, then allow a focused fix against `extensions/telegram/src/approval-handler.runtime.ts` with real Telegram proof.

options.title: Adopt and rework fork
options.body: Have a maintainer or contributor replace the fork PR’s obsolete handler edits with the current-runtime fix and required proof.

options.title: Wait for contributor
options.body: Keep this issue parked until the fork author rebases, removes unrelated edits, and supplies proof.

recommendation.title: Close fork and queue narrow fix
recommendation.body: Close the conflicting fork PR as obsolete, then allow a focused fix against `extensions/telegram/src/approval-handler.runtime.ts` with real Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The active runtime and removed-handler boundary were introduced in the native approval lifecycle refactor they authored.
